fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 5% of Gross Revenue, paid weekly. Marketing Allocation is 3% of Gross Revenue for Traditional Stores (all currently directed to Brand Development Fund, plus 1% local marketing recommended but not required) and 1% of Gross Revenue for Non-Traditional Stores (to Brand Development Fund; 1% local marketing recommended but not required). Interest on overdue amounts is the lesser of 1.5% per month or highest legal rate. Late charges at 18% per year or highest amount allowed by law, calculated weekly. NSF fee is $50 (increases to $100 for second or subsequent NSF in any rolling 12-month period). Additional training fee is $1,500 per person. Additional Store Opening Assistance is $1,500 per diem plus travel/lodging/dining. Renewal Fee is 25% of then-current initial franchise fee per store format. Transfer Fee (individual to business entity) is $1,500; Transfer Fee (owners transferring among themselves) is $2,500.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee 2 5% of Gross Revenue Weekly...
Marketing Allocation (Brand Development Fund and Local Marketing) 2 Traditional Store (i.e., SMOOTHIE FACTORY, SF+K-RED MANGO Co-Branded): 3% of Gross Revenue Weekly... Non-Traditional Store: 1% of Gross Revenue Weekly...
Interest Lesser of 1.5% per month or highest legal rate On demand...
Late Charges 18% per year or the highest amount allowed by law, calculated weekly. Continues to accrue until paid.
Charge for Nonpayment due to "Nonsufficient Funds" ("NSF") $50 (which will increase to $100 for any second or more NSF during any rolling 12-month period) plus reimbursement of our costs and expenses from your non-payment. On demand.
Initial Training and any Additional Training Currently, $1,500 (per person) On demand...
Store Opening Assistance Travel, lodging and dining costs of the individual we assign to provide Store opening assistance to you Upon demand...
Additional Store Opening Assistance $1,500 per each individual we assign to provide assistance to you per day Upon demand...
Renewal Fee (Franchise Agreement) 25% of the then current initial franchise fee, per store format (as applicable) Before renewal...
Transfer Fee – (payable if you are an individual transferring to a Business Entity for convenience of operation) $1,500 Before transfer.
Transfer Fee – (payable if your Owners are transferring among) $2,500 Before transfer.
